IDT12420.text:

Winds: East to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots shifting west to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon and evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. Near 100% chance of rain.

Winds: Westerly 15 to 25 knots decreasing to about 10 knots during the evening.

Seas: Below 1 metre.

IDT12420.synoptic: A low pressure system and associated trough over Victoria will move southwards across Tasmania on Saturday. A cold front is expected to cross the state on Sunday, with a cooler west to southwesterly airstream to follow that will persist throughout Monday. A high centre is then expected to pass to the north of Tasmania early on Tuesday and move away to the northeast during the day.
